recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not reintroduce the deleted core CodeSystem or duplicate the `activity` definition in core; future display or definition adjustments should go through THO/UTG Observation Category CodeSystem governance.
issue_request: FHIR-13862 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core OO issue from STU3. It requested adding a patient-reported physical activity category to the Observation.category value set, with examples such as laps swum, steps, and sleep data; the resolution text contains spelling variants such as `physical-activty`, but the applied code in history was `activity`.
initial_application: Git commit 9b52190635e745d4a09b61888e3a47a9ed9aa05b added `activity` with display `Activity` and the FHIR-13862 definition to `source/observation/codesystem-observation-category.xml`. The commit subject appears to swap nearby GForge issue numbers, because the same commit also worked on FHIR-13872 Observation.component examples. Later commits b63ba456ef969b5e173fc94623f34884301e68cc and 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 moved the code system URL to THO form and removed inline UTG content from core.
additional_context: The current core source owns `source/observation/valueset-observation-category.xml`, which includes all codes from `http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category`, and active `Observation.category` binds to that ValueSet. Later FHIR/UTG decisions, including FHIR-42844, UP-724, and implemented UP-738, revised the external THO definition of `activity` by removing the clinician-supervision sentence. Current THO still publishes code `activity`, display `Activity`, so the seed request remains satisfied through external terminology.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because adding or changing Observation Category concepts now belongs to the external THO/UTG CodeSystem, while FHIR core already imports that CodeSystem wholesale for the active ValueSet binding.
